title: SlopScan – Get this Extension for 🦊 Firefox (en-US)
excerpt: Download SlopScan for Firefox. Displays a "slop score" when viewing public git repositories
content_html:
This is a WebExtension for repo-slopscore which displays the "slop score" letter grade next to the repository name when viewing web-based git forges.

It requires a repo-slopscore web server, which defaults to the public instance at https://slopscan.ava.pet and is configurable in the extension preferences.

The extension currently supports displaying scores on:
- https://github.com
- https://codeberg.org
- https://git.sr.ht

Clicking the extension button on any page will attempt to scan the current URL.

Log in to rate this extension

There are no ratings yet

Required permissions:

  • Access browser tabs
  • Access your data for github.com
  • Access your data for codeberg.org
  • Access your data for git.sr.ht

Required data collection, according to the developer:

  • Website activity

content_html_zh:
这是 repo-slopscore 的 Web 扩展，在查看基于 Web 的 git forges 时，它会在存储库名称旁边显示“slop Score”字母等级。

它需要一个 repo-slopscore Web 服务器，默认为 https://slopscan.ava.pet 的公共实例，并且可以在扩展首选项中进行配置。

该扩展当前支持在以下位置显示分数：- https://github.com- https://codeberg.org- https://git.sr.ht

单击任意页面上的扩展按钮将尝试扫描当前 URL。

登录并评价此扩展程序

还没有评分

所需权限：

  • 访问浏览器选项卡
  • 访问您的 github.com 数据
  • 访问您的 codeberg.org 数据
  • 访问您的 git.sr.ht 数据

根据开发人员的说法，所需的数据收集：

  • 网站活动
